claim_scope: Consumed development mechanism qualification only; no effectiveness, generalization, or SOTA estimate.
hypothesis: Linking successful model-selected environment operations to a continuously growing executable program removes terminal program reconstruction, so a sufficient construction state can transition directly to target-state replay.

selection.reason: A prior certified-incumbent treatment observed a complete public-goal Pass but exhausted the session without forming a candidate.
Prior trajectories exposed a construction-to-target checkout ownership mismatch and same-session replay repair.

mechanisms: successful persistent operations appended verbatim to one ordered program
complete public-goal observation after every appended operation
automatic target-state replay on construction-goal Pass

qualification_observations: apply_environment_step calls and successful recorded steps
first sufficient state to replay delay in model requests
ordered replay outcomes and same-session repairs
exact accumulated program delivered after replay Pass
requests, tokens, wall time, network traffic, and storage

decision_policy.mechanism_qualified: The operation-linked program is used, every observed sufficient state triggers replay in the same tool turn, replay failure returns to the same session, and every delivered program is the accumulated replay-passing program.
decision_policy.mechanism_rejected: The Agent routinely bypasses the program path, a sufficient state fails to trigger replay, or accumulated operations cannot represent a valid target-state program.
decision_policy.effect_claim: No effect claim is permitted from these outcome-conditioned cases regardless of Official results.
